::: {#def-ci-diff-means}
#### Welch confidence interval for a difference in means

With the notation of @def-two-sample-t-test,
the **Welch $100(1-\alpha)\%$ confidence interval** for $\mu_1 - \mu_2$ is

$$(\bar{x}_1 - \bar{x}_2) \pm t_{\hat\nu,\, 1 - \alpha/2}
\sqrt{\frac{s_1^2}{n_1} + \frac{s_2^2}{n_2}},$$

where $t_{\hat\nu,\, 1 - \alpha/2}$ is the $1 - \alpha/2$ quantile
of the $t_{\hat\nu}$ distribution.
It is an approximate
[confidence interval](inference.qmd#def-confidence-interval).
:::
